records.name: ACT: ACT policy training and evaluation
records.summary: Pinned ACT entrypoint that trains on configured demonstrations or evaluates the resulting policy using its --eval mode in simulated or real ALOHA environments. Statically reviewed source only; not run and no Hub preparation adapter.
records.robot_scope: This train/evaluate file imports the aloha_scripts real environment in real mode; its pinned README specifically requires ALOHA for real operation. Simulation modes remain separate. No universal ALOHA support, prepared adapter or execution success is inferred.

license.scope: Selected first-party Python workflow source only. Preserve upstream copyright and per-file notices. Model weights, datasets, third-party code, robot drivers/firmware and services retain separate terms; no rights for those assets are inferred.

access.instructions: Fetch the pinned repository, verify this source checksum, and use upstream installation and invocation. This record does not install or execute code.

setup_evidence.purpose: ACT train/eval entrypoint, simulator and real-ALOHA scope, Python3.8.10 setup
Different declared Python3.9 environment and CUDA11.8 dependency
Separate Apache2 license for vendored DETR subtree, not the selected first-party workflow
Upstream DETR provenance and attribution for vendored model definitions

requirements.python: README Python3.8.10 and conda_env.yaml Python3.9 disagree; both are preserved without compatibility inference.
packages: Pinned ACT checkout
Torch/torchvision, MuJoCo and dm_control setup in README/conda_env.yaml
Separately installed modified DETR package; ALOHA package for real mode
requirements.display: Hardware: Training/evaluation explicitly calls .cuda() on policy and tensors. Simulator mode needs MuJoCo/dm_control; README says real mode additionally needs ALOHA installation/hardware. GPU memory minimum is not declared. Weights: Evaluation requires local policy_best.ckpt and dataset_stats.pkl. Training obtains selected demonstration data; external pretrained-backbone behavior in imported dependencies was not inspected. Datasets: Training uses a configured local demonstration dataset; evaluation uses matching dataset statistics. README links separately hosted simulation demonstrations. Services/auth: No cloud API key, provider token or online logging service is declared by this selected entrypoint. Imported dependencies and optional external assets remain outside this review.
requirements.notes: Train and --eval are modes of one physical source entrypoint, counted once. The Python/setup disagreement is an integration note, not hidden by a normalized version range. Code licensing does not establish model, checkpoint, dataset or service permission.

declared_requirements.python: README Python3.8.10 and conda_env.yaml Python3.9 disagree; both are preserved without compatibility inference.
declared_requirements.weights: Evaluation requires local policy_best.ckpt and dataset_stats.pkl. Training obtains selected demonstration data; external pretrained-backbone behavior in imported dependencies was not inspected.
declared_requirements.datasets: Training uses a configured local demonstration dataset; evaluation uses matching dataset statistics. README links separately hosted simulation demonstrations.
declared_requirements.hardware: Training/evaluation explicitly calls .cuda() on policy and tensors. Simulator mode needs MuJoCo/dm_control; README says real mode additionally needs ALOHA installation/hardware. GPU memory minimum is not declared.
declared_requirements.external_services_and_auth: No cloud API key, provider token or online logging service is declared by this selected entrypoint. Imported dependencies and optional external assets remain outside this review.

license_scopes.code: MIT for selected first-party workflow source.
license_scopes.weights: Selected evaluator requires a locally produced policy_best.ckpt and dataset_stats.pkl. Separate pretrained-backbone/dependency assets were not audited; first-party MIT is not extended to external weights.
license_scopes.datasets: README links separately hosted scripted/human demonstration data. That dataset's license/access terms were not inspected or inferred from the code license.
license_scopes.third_party_code: The pinned detr/LICENSE and detr/README.md declare Apache-2.0 for the modified DETR subtree. Root MIT applies to the selected first-party workflow, not all vendored/dependency code. External weights, data and dependencies retain separate terms.

declared_requirements.interpretation: Pinned upstream declarations only; no dependency resolution, model/data access, compatibility inference or runtime validation was performed.

invocation.notes: Train and --eval are modes of one physical source entrypoint, counted once. The Python/setup disagreement is an integration note, not hidden by a normalized version range.

No upstream code, installation, robot command, dataset, mesh or checkpoint was executed or loaded.

records.name: Genesis Panda IK, motion planning and grasp example
records.summary: Genesis World Python tutorial that solves Panda arm inverse kinematics, plans a joint path, controls joint position and gripper force, and lifts a simulated cube. The original script initializes a CPU simulation and opens a viewer at module top level; this record supplies inert source metadata only.

license.scope: Selected Python tutorial source under the pinned Genesis repository Apache-2.0 declaration. Preserve upstream attribution, license and applicable notices when redistributing. Robot descriptions, meshes, binaries and third-party dependencies retain their own terms and were not cleared by this source review.

requirements.python: >=3.10,<3.14 (upstream README declaration; untested)
packages: Genesis World from the pinned upstream checkout with its required dependencies
PyTorch installed for the intended platform before Genesis, as declared in the pinned README
numpy
system: CPU simulation backend explicitly selected by the source
Working graphics and display environment for show_viewer=True
Upstream Panda MJCF and adjacent assets required by xml/franka_emika_panda/panda.xml
requirements.notes: The source explicitly calls gs.init(backend=gs.cpu), provides no CPU/GPU command-line switch, and creates a viewer-enabled scene with dt=0.01. It loads the Panda model, configures nine DOF gains and force limits, solves pre-grasp/reach/lift IK, plans and draws a joint path, commands arm/finger positions, applies finger force and advances the simulation. PYTEST_VERSION shortens the default 200-waypoint path and later loops; that branch is not runtime evidence. A lone copy of this Python file is insufficient: model XML, meshes, a suitable Genesis/PyTorch installation and graphics support are needed. The model assets, their licenses and exact planning backend/package internals were not reviewed. README CPU/CUDA installation options and Python bounds are upstream declarations; no operating system, package versions, timing or simulator combination was resolved or tested.

invocation.notes: Upstream invocation after configuring the pinned checkout, dependencies, Panda assets and viewer environment. There is no main guard; importing or executing the original file initializes the simulator, opens the viewer and runs the simulation control sequence. The selected file has no hardware controller connection. Library initialization and transitive effects were not exhaustively audited. The Hub supplies no execution/preparation adapter, installs no package and claims no successful grasp, collision safety, physical-robot compatibility or measured runtime.

No simulator, upstream package, controller or GPU was executed.

system: Configured Nav2 planner server and lifecycle node loading this plugin
Start/goal poses in the configured global frame, footprint and active global costmap
Reviewed motion model, turning radius, unknown-space policy and search limits for the intended application
requirements.notes: configure creates AStarAlgorithm<NodeHybrid>, a footprint collision checker, optional smoother/downsampler and lifecycle path/debug publishers. Defaults include DUBIN motion model, allow_unknown=true, 72 angle bins and max_planning_time=5.0 seconds; these are source settings, not measured performance or universal robot parameters. createPlan locks the costmap, converts start/goal to grid bins, requests a path using the supplied cancellation callback, returns world-frame poses and may smooth within remaining configured time. Outside-map, occupied-start and search failures raise planner exceptions. A same-cell start/goal special case returns one pose. It can publish unsmoothed_plan, optional expansions/footprint markers and downsampled costmaps. Activation adds dynamic parameter and global-costmap resolution callbacks. CMake defaults C++17 when no standard is set and links OMPL/Eigen. No search helper, motion model, task result, controller or ROS/OS compatibility was executed or verified.

invocation.notes: Registered C++ shared-library plugin, not a ros2 run executable, standalone file or Hub recipe. Pinned nav2_smac_planner/smac_plugin_hybrid.xml names the class/base/library; CMake builds and exports it. A configured lifecycle host must load it through the intended Nav2 server. Read the full package, parameters and dependencies before any build or activation. The Hub only indexes one inert source file and did not compile, load or execute a plugin, ROS node, simulator or robot.

records.name: robot_localization extended Kalman filter implementation
records.summary: Official C++ Ekf library implementation for selective measurement correction and nonlinear state/covariance prediction in robot_localization. This source mutates filter state and covariance; it is not a standalone ROS node, sensor-interface implementation or verified localization task.

license.scope: Selected src/ekf.cpp has a complete BSD-3-Clause notice, copyright 2014-2016 Charles River Analytics, Inc. and 2017 Locus Robotics, Inc. Preserve its copyright, conditions, disclaimer and non-endorsement requirement. Root LICENSE includes Charles River Analytics and Austin Robot Technology BSD notices, with an organization placeholder in one clause; package.xml instead declares Apache License 2.0. Verification is limited to the explicit, complete selected-file notice. It does not relicense or clear the full package, other components, dependencies or binaries.

packages: Complete pinned robot_localization package, rl_lib, headers and FilterBase/Measurement implementations
ament_cmake
builtin_interfaces
rosidl_default_generators
rosidl_default_runtime
rosidl_typesupport_cpp
rclcpp
rmw_implementation
angles
Eigen3 / eigen
Boost / libboost-dev
GeographicLib / geographiclib
geographic_msgs
geometry_msgs
diagnostic_msgs
diagnostic_updater
message_filters
nav_msgs
sensor_msgs
std_msgs
std_srvs
tf2

tf2_geometry_msgs
tf2_ros
yaml_cpp_vendor
yaml-cpp
system: Caller-provided initialized filter state, covariance, measurement/update masks and process/control settings
Consistent units, frames, measurement timing and rclcpp Time/Duration values
C++ toolchain and generated package interfaces required by the reviewed CMake configuration
requirements.notes: correct selects finite measured dimensions, takes the absolute value of negative covariance diagonals, floors very small diagonal variances at 1e-9, computes a Kalman gain by matrix inversion, normalizes angular innovation, applies a Mahalanobis threshold and updates state/covariance using the Joseph form. predict builds an Euler-angle transfer function and analytical Jacobian, calls inherited control preparation, optionally computes dynamic process noise, projects state/covariance and wraps state angles. It uses 1/cos(pitch); numerical conditioning and singularity behavior were not tested. These methods mutate filter internals and can emit configured debug output; this file defines no main, ROS subscriptions/publishers or physical robot command. CMake places src/ekf.cpp in rl_lib and separately builds ekf_node from another source that was not read in this bounded review. CMake selects C++17 for non-WIN32 builds. Package version 3.8.3 and ROS Index jazzy-devel metadata are declarations, not tested ROS, OS, architecture, Python or sensor compatibility. A fetched file alone is insufficient.

invocation.notes: Library methods, not a shell command or standalone source-file executable. The selected file defines predict(const rclcpp::Time &, const rclcpp::Duration &) and correct(const Measurement &). Its complete package supplies class declarations, inherited filter state/utilities and caller integration. Reviewed CMake links rl_lib into a separate ekf_node target, but that target main and ROS filter I/O were not reviewed here. No Hub build, install or execution adapter is provided; no upstream library, ROS node, simulator or robot was compiled, loaded or run.

access.instructions: Read the selected implementation, complete per-file notice, package declarations and CMake configuration before integrating the full upstream library. This source reference only retrieves one inert file; it does not provide a prepared sensor-fusion node or run a localization task.

evidence.inspection: Official ROS Index canonical repository/ref evidence, exact commit and complete tree reviewed. Complete EKF implementation, root license, package XML and CMake read as inert text; all four immutable file bodies matched tree Git blobs and sizes. Library entrypoints, mutation boundaries, declared dependencies and BSD-file/Apache-package distinction inspected. No compiler, imports, installation, ROS execution, sensor data, numerical test or physical compatibility verification.

records.name: ros2_controllers differential-drive controller implementation
records.summary: Official C++ ros2_control chainable plugin that consumes stamped linear/angular velocity references, applies configured limits and computes left/right wheel velocity commands. It integrates odometry through a companion helper and publishes configured odometry/TF output; runtime and physical behavior remain untested.

license.scope: Copyright 2020 PAL Robotics S.L.; selected-file author notice names Bence Magyar, Enrique Fernández and Manuel Meraz. The selected source explicitly declares Apache License 2.0; the complete pinned root LICENSE and matching package.xml declaration were reviewed. Preserve applicable copyright, license, modification and notice obligations. Verification is limited to the selected source text, not all dependencies, companion implementations, binaries, hardware drivers or deployment.

packages: Complete pinned diff_drive_controller package, companion sources/headers and a C++17 toolchain
ament_cmake
ros2_control_cmake
generate_parameter_library
backward_ros
control_toolbox
controller_interface
geometry_msgs
hardware_interface
nav_msgs
pluginlib
rclcpp
rclcpp_lifecycle
rcpputils
realtime_tools
tf2

rosidl_runtime_cpp
system: Configured ros2_control lifecycle/controller manager host and matching left/right wheel velocity command interfaces
Configured wheel names, radii/separation, velocity limits, timing and odometry frames; position/velocity feedback unless configured open_loop
requirements.notes: The subscriber path uses the package TwistStamped alias on ~/cmd_vel and checks timestamp age; timeout 0 disables this timeout. The chainable class exposes linear/angular velocity reference interfaces. update_and_write_commands applies speed limiters, computes wheel rates from linear x/angular z and configured geometry, and writes loaned wheel command handles. It delegates odometry to odometry.cpp, publishes ~/odom and conditional /tf and ~/cmd_vel_out, and halt writes zero wheel commands during deactivation. These are source operations, not verified stopping, odometry accuracy or timing. Complete headers, odometry/speed-limiter helpers and generated parameter YAML/validators were not reviewed and remain required. Package/CMake declare the listed build/runtime dependencies; lifecycle_msgs, class_loader and rosidl_runtime_cpp also appear directly in this source. Optional BUILD_TESTING has additional declared test dependencies. C++17, package 4.43.0 and the jazzy checkout are declarations, not tested environment combinations.

invocation.notes: The plugin XML registers type diff_drive_controller::DiffDriveController, base controller_interface::ChainableControllerInterface and shared library diff_drive_controller. This source registers that class with CLASS_LOADER_REGISTER_CLASS; CMake exports diff_drive_plugin.xml. A complete configured controller manager/lifecycle host supplies interfaces and invokes subscriber/reference and command updates. This is not a standalone executable or Hub adapter. When loaded by an authorized host it can command actual wheels and publish ROS messages; fetching this reference never loads or executes it.
